festival.today: Today is the {name} in the Village! Open {from} - {to}.
festival.notYet: The {name} opens at {time}. Come back later!
festival.over: The {name} is over for today. See you next time!
festival.done: You already took part in this today.
festival.welcome.market: Stalls line the road and the air smells of fresh bread and coffee. Everyone sells at a better price today!
festival.welcome.independence: Red and white flags flutter over the road. Sack races and cracker eating - join the games and win prizes!
festival.welcome.harvest: Baskets of pumpkins and lanterns everywhere. Show off your best harvest and share a meal with the village!
festival.prompt.sell: Tap A: sell at the market (+25%)
festival.prompt.contest: Tap A: enter the Harvest Contest
festival.sell.done: Sold {count} items at market prices for {coins}g (+25%)!
festival.deal.coins: The bargain costs {cost}g. You do not have enough.
festival.contest.none: You have nothing to enter. Bring something you grew, caught or cooked!
festival.contest.result: You entered {item}! The judges give you {rank}. Prize: {coins}g.
festival.feast.done: You shared a big meal with the villagers. Everyone likes you a little more! (+2 friendship with {n} villagers)
game.sack.title: Sack Race
game.sack.hint: Tap as fast as you can!
game.krupuk.title: Cracker Eating
game.krupuk.hint: Tap when the marker is in the green zone!
